x.description: Dimension value (e.g. a path or country).

y.description: Count of views/events or unique visitors.

comparison.description: The same totals for the comparison period (previous period by default).

bearerAuth.description: Token returned by POST /api/auth/login, or an API key (`umami_…`) created under Settings → API keys (self-hosted only).

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 access token (authorization code + PKCE). Only operations that declare an OAuth scope accept these tokens.

scopes.analytics:read: Read analytics data (traffic, metrics, events, sessions, reports).
scopes.websites:read: List and view websites you have access to.

shareContext.description: Required context header when authenticating with a share token.
shareContext.name: x-umami-share-context

shareToken.description: Signed token returned by a share endpoint.
shareToken.name: x-umami-share-token

info.description: REST API for Umami analytics. Every App Router API operation is included. Operations marked with x-umami-contract: inferred are generated from handler source; colocated explicit contracts provide curated descriptions and exact response models. Self-hosted deployments serve these paths beneath their configured BASE_PATH.
info.title: Umami API

post.description: Disables two-factor authentication for the current user after verifying their password and authenticator code. Rejected when an administrator or team requires it.
Deletes the current user's pending setup without changing an already enabled authenticator.
Verifies an authenticator code, enables two-factor authentication, and returns a new set of backup codes.
Starts or replaces the current user's pending setup and returns a QR code and manual setup key for an authenticator app.

get.description: Returns whether two-factor authentication is enabled, configured, or required for the current user, including the reason it is required.

post.description: Exchanges a partial sign-in token and a valid authenticator or backup code for a full authentication token and user details.
Enables or disables the installation-wide requirement for users to set up two-factor authentication.
post.summary: Set the two-factor requirement for everyone

get.description: Returns a paginated list of teams with member details and website and member counts for administration.

post.description: Enables or disables the requirement for members of the specified team to use two-factor authentication.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users and their website counts for administration, excluding passwords.

delete.description: Removes the specified user's authenticator setup, backup codes, used-code history, and failed-attempt limits so they can set up authentication again.

get.description: Returns whether two-factor authentication is enabled for the specified user.

post.description: Enables or disables the requirement for the specified user to set up two-factor authentication.

get.description: Returns a paginated, searchable list of websites across users and teams for administration.

post.description: Authenticates a user with a username and password. Users with two-factor authentication receive a short-lived partial token to complete sign-in.
Ends the current authentication session by removing its stored token when Redis-backed sessions are enabled.
Returns the authenticated user and a new token valid for 24 hours. Requires Redis-backed authentication.

get.description: Returns subscription and feature availability for the current user or a specified team the user can access.

post.description: Validates the current authentication credentials and returns the user and their team memberships.
Processes up to 500 tracking payloads and returns processed and failed counts, individual error details, and a tracking cache token.
post.summary: Send a batch of tracking requests

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the current user's boards, with search and sorting options.

post.description: Creates a board with a name, type, and configuration, optionally assigned to a team. Validates access to its referenced resources and reports.

delete.description: Deletes the specified board after checking the caller's permission to remove it.

get.description: Returns the specified board and its configuration.

post.description: Updates a board's name, description, or configuration and validates the resources and reports it references.
Creates a copy of a board with optional changes to its name, description, and configuration. Removes invalid report references from the copy.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of shares for the specified board.

post.description: Creates a named share for the specified board with optional parameters.
post.summary: Create a share for a board

get.description: Returns public application settings, including deployment mode, feature availability, and tracker and resource URLs.
Returns the current user's personal dashboard board and its configuration.

post.description: Creates or updates the current user's personal dashboard with the supplied name, description, and configuration.

get.description: Returns a simple success response to confirm that the application can serve requests.
Returns a paginated list of the current user's tracked links, with search and sorting options.

post.description: Creates a tracked link with a name, destination URL, and slug, optionally assigned to a team.

delete.description: Deletes the specified tracked link after checking the caller's permission to remove it.

get.description: Returns the specified tracked link, including its destination URL and slug.

post.description: Updates a tracked link's name, destination URL, or slug.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of shares for the specified link.

post.description: Creates a named share for the specified link with optional parameters.
post.summary: Create a share for a link

get.description: Returns visitor totals and chart data for the requested links the caller can view, within the selected date range.
Returns the current authentication context, including the authenticated user or share credentials.
Returns metadata for the current user's API keys. Available on self-hosted installations.

post.description: Creates a named API key for the current user and returns its secret value. Available on self-hosted installations.

delete.description: Deletes an API key belonging to the current user, revoking its access. Available on self-hosted installations.

post.description: Verifies the current password and replaces it with the supplied new password.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of teams the current user belongs to, with sorting options.
Returns a paginated list of the current user's websites, optionally including websites accessible through team membership.
Validates an OAuth authorization request and returns the client and requested permissions for the consent screen. Requires an interactive user session.

post.description: Records the user's consent decision and returns a redirect URL. Approval includes an authorization code, the request state, and the issuer.
Registers a public OAuth client for clients that do not support Client ID Metadata Documents. Clients that support them should use an HTTPS metadata URL as their client ID.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Unknown tokens are accepted without revealing whether they existed.
Exchanges an authorization code and PKCE verifier, or a refresh token, for an access token. Accepts form-encoded or JSON requests and rotates refresh tokens on use.
post.summary: Get or refresh an OAuth access token

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the current user's tracking pixels, with search and sorting options.

post.description: Creates a tracking pixel with a name and slug, optionally assigned to a team.

delete.description: Deletes the specified tracking pixel after checking the caller's permission to remove it.

get.description: Returns the specified tracking pixel and its configuration.

post.description: Updates a tracking pixel's name or slug.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of shares for the specified tracking pixel.
get.summary: List shares for a tracking pixel

post.description: Creates a named share for the specified tracking pixel with optional parameters.
post.summary: Create a share for a tracking pixel

get.description: Returns visitor totals and chart data for the requested pixels the caller can view, within the selected date range.
get.summary: Get visitor charts for tracking pixels

get.description: Returns recent website activity and visitor data for the real-time view, applying the supplied filters.

post.description: Stores session replay events or heatmap clicks and scrolls for a website, using a valid tracking cache token to identify the session and visit.
post.summary: Send session recordings or heatmap data

get.description: Returns a paginated list of saved reports for the requested website, optionally filtered by report type.

post.description: Saves a report's name, description, type, and parameters for a website so it can be opened again later.

delete.description: Deletes the specified saved report definition.

get.description: Returns the specified report's saved name, description, type, and parameters.

post.description: Updates the specified report's website, name, description, type, and parameters.
Calculates how traffic sources contribute to conversions using the supplied attribution settings, date range, and filters.
Groups website activity by the selected dimensions for the requested date range and filters.
Calculates visitor progression through a sequence of pages or events using the supplied funnel steps and filters.
Counts visitors who reached a matching page or triggered a matching event and returns the total visitor count for comparison.
Returns recorded click or scroll data for the selected page and date range to display as a heatmap.
Returns paths through pages or events using the supplied journey settings and website filters.
Returns performance trends, summary metrics, and breakdowns by page, page title, device, and browser for the selected website and date range.
Calculates how groups of visitors return over time using the supplied retention settings, date range, and filters.
Returns revenue trends, totals with a comparison period, and breakdowns by country, region, referrer, and channel.
Returns traffic breakdowns for UTM source, medium, campaign, term, and content using the supplied date range and filters.

get.description: Returns JavaScript that sends the application version through a telemetry pixel, or an inactive script when telemetry is disabled.

200.description: Successful response. The response shape is inferred as free-form because the handler does not expose a reusable response schema.

post.description: Collects a pageview, custom event, visitor identification, or performance payload and returns session information and a tracking cache token when accepted.
Creates a named share for a website, board, link, or pixel with parameters and an optional custom slug.

get.description: Resolves a public share slug and returns its resource references, parameters, and an access token scoped to the shared resources.
get.summary: Open a share by its slug

delete.description: Deletes the specified share after checking permission to delete shares for its resource.

get.description: Returns a share's configuration by its ID after checking access to the shared resource.

post.description: Updates the specified share's name, slug, and parameters.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of teams the current user belongs to, with sorting options.

post.description: Creates a team with an access code and an owner. Administrators can specify a different user as the owner.

delete.description: Deletes the specified team after checking the caller's permission to remove it.

get.description: Returns the specified team's details, including its members.

post.description: Updates the specified team's name or access code.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of boards belonging to the specified team, with search and sorting options.
Returns a paginated list of tracked links belonging to the specified team, with search and sorting options.
Returns a paginated list of tracking pixels belonging to the specified team, with search and sorting options.
Returns a paginated list of members of the specified team, including usernames and membership details.

post.description: Adds an existing user to the specified team with the supplied team role.

delete.description: Removes a user's membership from the specified team, subject to team role and ownership restrictions.

get.description: Returns the specified user's membership details for a team.

post.description: Updates a user's role in the specified team, subject to the caller's role and permissions.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of websites belonging to the specified team, with search and sorting options.

post.description: Adds the current user to a team as a member using the team's access code.
Creates a user account with the supplied username, password, and role.

delete.description: Deletes the specified user account. The current user cannot delete their own account through this operation.

get.description: Returns details for the specified user account when the caller has permission to view it.

post.description: Updates a user's password. Administrators can also change the username and role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of teams for the specified user. Available to that user and administrators.
Returns a paginated list of the specified user's websites, optionally including team access. Available to that user and administrators.
Returns a paginated list of the current user's websites, optionally including websites accessible through team membership.

parameters.description: When present, include websites accessible through owned or managed teams.
parameters.name: includeTeams

schema.description: When present, include websites accessible through owned or managed teams.

post.description: Creates a website with a name and domain, optionally assigning it to a team and creating a share.

delete.description: Deletes the specified website after checking the caller's permission to remove it.

get.description: Returns the specified website's details and configuration.

200.description: Website details, or null if it does not exist.

post.description: Updates a website's name, domain, sharing settings, or recording configuration.

get.description: Returns the number of visitors active on the website in the last few minutes.
Returns a paginated list of dated notes for the website, optionally filtered by date range or search text.

post.description: Adds a dated note to the website, optionally marking it as an all-day annotation.

delete.description: Deletes the specified dated note from the website.

get.description: Returns the date, all-day setting, and note for a specific website annotation.

post.description: Changes the date, all-day setting, and note for a website annotation.

get.description: Returns the earliest and latest recorded event dates for the website.
get.summary: Get the website's available date range

get.description: Returns a page of events in the selected date range, grouping each event's custom property records together.
Returns a page of occurrences of the specified event, with event details and property keys and values grouped into one row per occurrence.
get.summary: List event properties in table form

get.description: Counts individual values in an array property for the specified event, grouped by value and time interval.
get.summary: Get event array values over time

get.description: Counts occurrences of dates stored in the specified event property, grouping by the property's date value within the selected event date range.
get.summary: Get the distribution of event date values

get.description: Returns the sum, average, or count of a numeric property for the specified event, grouped by time interval.
get.summary: Get numeric event properties over time

get.description: Returns the total, average, median, minimum, and maximum of the specified numeric event property for the selected date range and filters.
Counts occurrences of string values in the specified event property, grouped by value and time interval.
get.summary: Get event property values over time

get.description: Returns the custom property records, data types, and values attached to a specific event.
Returns property names, types, and counts grouped by event name. When an event is specified, also groups by property value.
Returns property names, data types, and counts for the selected date range, optionally restricted to an event name.
Returns event names and their custom property names, data types, and record counts for the selected date range and filters.
Returns counts of events with custom data, distinct property names, and property records for the selected date range and filters.
Returns values and their occurrence counts for a custom event property, optionally restricted by event name and data type.
Returns a page of pageviews and custom events in the date range, newest first. Supports filtering by event name and searching event details.
Returns counts grouped by event name and time interval, optionally limited to the most frequent event names.
get.summary: Get custom event counts over time

get.description: Returns website event totals for the selected date range and filters, including totals for the comparison period.
Returns a base64-encoded ZIP archive containing CSV exports of events, pages, referrers, browsers, operating systems, devices, and countries.

get.description: Returns the most frequent values for a dimension such as pages, referrers, countries, browsers, campaigns, or events. Counts pageviews or events for activity dimensions and unique visitors for visitor dimensions.

parameters.description: Dimension to rank: path, entry, exit, title, query, hostname, referrer, domain, channel, event, tag, browser, os, device, screen, language, country, region, city, distinctId, utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmTerm.
parameters.name: type

schema.description: Dimension to rank: path, entry, exit, title, query, hostname, referrer, domain, channel, event, tag, browser, os, device, screen, language, country, region, city, distinctId, utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmTerm.

get.description: Returns additional analytics for the selected page, event, visitor, or channel dimension, using the supplied date range and filters.

get.description: Returns public replay and heatmap settings, including sampling, masking, and duration limits. Returns disabled status when recording is unavailable.
Returns a paginated list of recorded sessions for the website, applying date, replay, and search filters.

Returns a paginated, searchable list of replays saved for the website.
Returns whether the specified replay is in the website's saved replays.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of saved report definitions for the website, optionally filtered by report type.

post.description: Clears the website's collected analytics data while keeping the website configuration.

get.description: Returns revenue chart data for the selected currency, date range, and website filters.
Returns revenue grouped by the requested dimension, such as country or referrer, for the selected currency and date range.
Returns a paginated list of sessions with revenue in the selected currency and date range, applying website and search filters.
Returns revenue summary statistics for the selected currency and date range, including totals for the comparison period.
Returns saved segments or cohorts for the website, filtered by the requested type and search text.

post.summary: Create a website segment or cohort

delete.description: Deletes the specified saved segment or cohort from the website.
delete.summary: Delete a website segment or cohort

get.description: Returns a saved segment or cohort and its filter parameters for the website.
get.summary: Get a website segment or cohort

post.description: Updates a saved segment or cohort's type, name, and filter parameters.
post.summary: Update a website segment or cohort

get.description: Returns a page of sessions matching the selected property and filters, with the latest property keys and values grouped into one row per session.
get.summary: List session properties in table form

get.description: Counts distinct sessions for individual values in an array property, grouped by value and time interval.
get.summary: Get session array values over time

get.description: Counts distinct sessions by dates stored in the specified custom property, using the selected date range and filters.

get.description: Returns the sum, average, or count of a numeric session property, grouped by time interval for the selected date range and filters.

get.description: Returns the total, average, median, minimum, and maximum of the specified numeric session property for the selected date range and filters.

Counts distinct sessions for string values in a custom property, grouped by value and time interval.
get.summary: Get session property values over time

get.description: Returns session, visit, pageview, event, and total activity counts grouped by values of the specified session property.
Returns custom session property values and their occurrence counts, optionally filtered by property name and data type.
Returns a page of visitor sessions in the date range, newest first. Search matches distinct ID, city, browser, operating system, or device.

get.description: Returns details for a website session, including linked visitor identities and whether session deletion is available to the caller.
Returns activity for the specified session and sessions linked by visitor identity, using the requested date range and optional distinct ID.
Returns custom property records, data types, and values for the specified website session.
Returns a paginated, searchable list of recordings for the specified website session.
Returns aggregate session metrics for the website over the selected date range and filters.
Returns distinct visitor counts grouped by day of the week and hour in the selected timezone and date range.
get.summary: Get traffic by weekday and hour

get.description: Returns a paginated list of shares for the specified website.

post.description: Creates a named share for the specified website with optional parameters.
post.summary: Create a share for a website

get.description: Returns pageviews, unique visitors, visits, bounces, and total time on site for the selected date range and comparison period.
